description: torch.linalg.eigh loops cuSOLVER syevd one matrix at a time for n>32 (profile: 100% SIMT, sytrd+GEMV+laed, zero tensor-core), so the bottleneck is per-matrix launch serialization and no batching. Replace the whole solve with a genuinely BATCHED symmetric eigensolver via torch load_inline CUDA C++: try cusolverDnXsyevBatched (CUDA 13.3 64-bit API; confirm it accepts n=512/1024/2048 and fall back to a custom batched path if it caps at n<=32), driving all matrices in one batched call and returning FP32 (Q,L). Reduce sweeps/tolerance where the API allows since the residual gates are ~1-2 digits. Target every shape.
